criteria.label: verified_closed_multi_pool_arbitrage
criteria.criterion: Actual distinct-pool route plus matched positive closed assets after observed onchain costs. High gas is not the criterion.
criteria.can_claim: Observed arbitrage surplus on the stated operational boundary; no common-beneficial-owner assertion.

criteria.label: inventory_sale_reference_edge
criteria.criterion: Signed incident-pool swap delta marked at frozen market prices, less observed cost once.
criteria.can_claim: Reference execution margin only; no historical acquisition/hedge cost or causal MEV certification.

criteria.label: priority_or_direct_block_payment
criteria.criterion: Actual gas priority or actual trace/claim payment to block recipient.
criteria.can_claim: Ordering/auction payment evidence; a payment alone does not prove arbitrage, frontrunning or sandwiching.

criteria.label: target_association
criteria.criterion: Same authenticated pool/PoolId, after first monitored target, within the common window. Before-target activity stays control.
criteria.can_claim: Association only; organic trading can remain.

criteria.label: causal_execution_effect
criteria.criterion: Historical-state replay comparing actual execution with removal/reordering of specified front legs; report feasibility, failures and unique targets.
criteria.can_claim: Only the tested replay increment under its assumptions; not whole-event MEV.

overlap_rule: Existing closed-cycle and replay catalogues are annotations, not extra rows added to the unified budget.
